text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I escort Symboli Rudolf to the<n>infirmary after she
suffers an injury<n>during training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is nothing, Trainer—hardly more<n>than a bruise. It
will heal in no time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I were to falter at a scratch like this,<n>I would be
ashamed to call myself<n>Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Why, I could resume training<n>tomorrow if you
wanted. Haha...
choice_data_list: I was hoping you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I had hoped a little humor would<n>reassure you,
but it seems to have<n>had the opposite effect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I see now that putting<n>up a brave
front is not always the<n>best answer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf makes to get up, only<n>to freeze
mid-motion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I was a little hasty in my<n>assessment. I
may need time to<n>recuperate after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So much for sparing my dignity...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then we are of one mind. No hardship<n>is too
onerous for the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm always vigilant for opportunities<n>to put my
ideals into practice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is one such time. I will not be<n>undone by a
minor mishap!
